latest_target.source_text: TISCO Securities · ## TSLA — บทวิเคราะห์รายบริษัท: TSLA260727 --- page 1 --- Page | 1 สี สี สี Global DR Update - Tesla Tesla Inc. Underlying Stock Stock Exchange of Underlying DR TSLA US The Nasdaq Global Select Market TSLA80 Earnings Miss Overshadowed Strong Revenue Growth 2QFY26 Earnings Review: • Tesla reported revenue of US$28.2bn (+26% YoY, +26% QoQ), beating Bloomberg consensus by 7%, driven by automotive and services revenue. • Higher cost and a 47% YoY increase in operating expenses pressured operating profit which fell 57% YoY and 58% QoQ to US$0.39bn. Operating profit margin was 1.4%, below the consensus estimate of 5.2%. • Net profit was US$1.11bn (-5% YoY, +134% QoQ), missing the market estimate by 7% despite support from gains in other income. • CAPEX increased 145% YoY and 132% QoQ to US$5.79bn, but was 12% below market expectations. • The number of tesla deliveries grew 25% YoY to 480,126 units this quarter, above Bloomberg consensus of 396,466 units supported by a recovery in demand across key markets, including Europe, US and China. Higher spending Weighed on Share Price: • Tesla has entered a major investment cycle, management expects CAPEX to exceed US$25bn in FY26F and remains high over the next 2- 3 years as the company invest in AI initiatives and infrastructure. • The company’s focus continues to shift from vehicle sales toward innovation projects. Management also highlighted long-term robotics ambitions, stating that “Optimus will be the biggest product ever”. • We reiterate our “SELL” rating on TSLA US due to its premium valuation, the challenges on supply chain constraints and heavy investment while returns may take a long time to materialize. • TSLA US is trading at 204x and 172x for FY26F-27F PER with profit growth estimated at 43% and 18% respectively.
